data.gender_notes: Nihlah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Nihlah means 'Lotus Flower'. This beautiful and meaningful name is derived from the Arabic word 'Nahlah', which refers to the lotus flower. In Islamic culture, the lotus flower is a symbol of purity, grace, and enlightenment. It is often associated with spiritual growth and the attainment of inner peace. The name Nihlah carries the meaning “Lotus Flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nihlah usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nihlah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
